newsitem.title: USA: ITEQ Inc unit awarded $4 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: ITEQ Inc unit awarded $4 mln contract.

text.p: ITEQ Inc said on Friday that its subsidiary, Ohmstede Inc, has been awarded a $4 million contract to supply heat exchangers to a refining company in Gujrat, India.
Ohmstede and Allied Industries International Ltd will manufacture the units for delivery by Spring 1998.
Ohmstede, based in Beaumont, Texas, designs and manufactures shell and tube heat exchangers.
ITEQ provides manufactured equipment, engineered systems and services used in the processing, treatment and movement of gases and liquids.
